# CV Generator

> Full-stack application for generating professional CV documents with AI-powered assistance — React + TypeScript frontend, Python FastAPI backend, and Neo4j graph database.

CV Generator provides a web interface for creating tailored CVs, AI-powered drafting from job descriptions, multiple professional themes, and DOCX/HTML export. Built by Babak Bandpey at [Cocode](https://cocode.dk).

## Application

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/cv-generator): Full source code
- [GitHub Pages Demo](https://cv.cocode.dk/): Live frontend demo
